description: Puts the forge and vi-natural CLIs on PATH at session start. Before a call: refuses the shell commands whose damage cannot be undone, and stops once before a memory or skill write, including through the shell where the content cannot be read, and after a call when one of those files changed by a route no check reads. After a call: hands every code file that changed — whichever route wrote it — to the linter the project itself configured, its own copy where it has one and the vendored one where it does not, and asks once when a checker is about to hard-code the cases it already knows. This plugin owns when and where a rule fires; the project owns what the rule says. It also refuses a CLAUDE.md write that leaves a claim about this repository the repository does not bear out, and records the documents a turn changed and asks once for a second model to read them. Before a commit it holds one whose staged documents are on the unread list, or whose last review made findings nobody ruled on. Before a write to an issue it lists that issue's comments itself: an empty list passes silently, and comments the session has not been shown are delivered in the refusal, since the read that looks complete returns none of them. Before a filing it reads the title and the body against the shape the flow needs, on this CLI's own verb and on the tracker's create alike, and refuses one too small to carry the flow with the routes that fit it instead.

hooks.command: node "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}"/hooks/gate.mjs pre bash-guard codex-second learning-gate issue-read-first
node "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}"/hooks/gate.mjs post learning-landed claude-md derive-dont-list codex-turn code-quality
